scope: Exact copied portable selection runtime3 plus unchanged row profile; read-only candidate. Two isolated adversarial race regressions; no broad qualifiers, canonical/source mutations, GUI, Prism or Git.

findings.problem: Same-stamp captured membership only validates presence, not agreement with the current accessed row. A valid immutable index can swap admitted interior row2 with hidden row8 while range endpoints1/3 agree, so Shift1→3 accepts row2 unselected and hidden row8 selected.
findings.fix: For same Scope/current stamp, verify captured row identity/index equals each bounded admitted current row before transition commit and Snapshot. Later-revision view keys retain normal captured membership semantics.

findings.problem: Snapshot checks live row/stamp then calls captured-index metadata without a final live stamp check. That later callback can coincide with live source revision advancement while the captured index itself remains immutable; Snapshot returns stale revision1 against live revision2.
findings.fix: After final selection.current(), recheck sameStamp(live source,current stamp), matching the added commit-path guard ordering.

positive_assessment: Representation supports stable-key additions outside the original index with bounded detached sparse maps, checked MaxInt count and deterministic worker iteration.
Clear valid-only recovery and new-incarnation reset avoid reading a broken old capture; same-incarnation replacement preserves captured membership explicitly.

Range/All reads endpoints plus capacity-admitted visible/overscan rows without scanning hidden rows. Selection snapshots have no Grid/application backpointer; retained index memory is explicitly borrowed.
limitations: Full new producer tests/spec/native/consumer are not covered by this early portable runtime review. Candidate is still developing; these exact original copies and RED evidence remain immutable.
